title: Fourier expansion recovers the function
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$. Its Walsh–Fourier expansion recovers $f$ at every point: \[f(x)=\sum_{S\subseteq[n]}\widehat f(S)\chi_S(x),\qquad x\in\{0,1\}^n,\] where $\widehat f(S)=\mathbb E_y[f(y)\chi_S(y)]$ and $\chi_S$ is the Walsh character.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the Boolean cube
